title: Intermediate curvature and splitting theorem
summary: In this paper, we prove several rigidity results for complete noncompact manifolds with nonnegative intermediate curvatures. We show that when either $3\leq n\leq 5$, $1\leq m\leq n-1$, or $6\leq n\leq 7$, $m\in \{1,n-1,n-2\}$, any manifold of the topological type $M^{n-m}\times \mathbb{T}^{m-1}\times \mathbb{R}$ with nonnegative $m$-intermediate curvature is isometrically covered by the canonical product $M\times \mathbb{R}^m$.
